CITY OF SAN MARINO

  PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA

John Dustin, Chair  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Shelley Boyle, Vice Chair  (626) 300-0711 Phone
Howard Brody, Commissioner  (626) 300-0716 Fax
Kevin Cheng, Commissioner  City Hall Council Chamber
Jeri Wright, Commissioner  2200 Huntington Drive
James Okazaki, Alternate  San Marino, CA 91108
Monte Ross, Alternate

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 24, 2021 AT 7:00 P.M.

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Planning
Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular Meetings are held on the 4th Wednesday of every month at 7:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (626) 300-0705 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  PURSUANT TO EXECUTIVE ORDER N-29-20
Members of the Planning Commission may teleconference into the meeting without noticing
each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
As a precaution to protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, the City is asking
members of the public to follow the State Health Department’s guidance on large gatherings
when deciding whether to attend this meeting. In that regard, all seating in the Council meeting
will be spaced by at least six feet to minimize close contact. Close contact, such as shaking
hands, is strongly discouraged. Although public access to the meeting in person will be allowed,
if you are sick or identify yourself as being “higher risk” based on the CDC’s guidelines, you are
encouraged to watch or listen to the meeting from home or provide input electronically.

Members of the public may observe and offer comment at this meeting telephonically or
otherwise electronically:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to acervantes@cityofsanmarino.org before or
  during the meeting, prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read by the
  Clerk during public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the
  interest of time.

  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module.
 PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA – MARCH 24, 2021  PAGE 2 OF 4

If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable modification or accommodation
pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”) please contact the Community
Development Director via email at acervantes@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-
0710 prior to the meeting for assistance.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION, please contact the Community Development
Department at (626) 300-0700. A copy of the staff reports under review at this Planning
Commission meeting will be available for public review by the end of the day on March 19,
2021 on the City’s website at: www.cityofsanmarino.org

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88616418757
  Meeting ID: 886 1641 8757

  2) Submit Public Comments via email:
  Email: acervantes@cityofsanmarino.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Commissioner Howard Brody, Commissioner Kevin Cheng,
  Commissioner Jeri Wright, Alternate James Okazaki, Alternate Monte
  Ross, Vice Chair Shelley Boyle and Chair John Dustin.

POSTING OF AGENDA

The meeting agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each special meeting at the following locations:
City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Recreation Department, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The meeting agenda is also posted on the
City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Section 54954.3 of the Brown Act provides an opportunity for members of the public to
address the Planning Commission on any item of interest to the public, before or during the
Planning Commission’s consideration of the item, that is within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Planning Commission.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  1. DESIGN REVIEW NO. DRC19-57HP
  1215 SAINT ALBANS RD., (WANG/DIG INC.)
 PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA – MARCH 24, 2021  PAGE 3 OF 4

  The applicant requests to construct a new two-story residence with an attached one-car
  garage and a detached two-car garage. This requires one design review action pursuant
  to City Code Section 23.15.03(B).
  (Required Action Date: 5/3/2021)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve Design
  Review No. DRC19-57HP subject to the attached Conditions of Approval.

  2.  DESIGN REVIEW NO. DRC 20-57HP
  2920 SHEFFIELD RD., (YUNG/CHAN)
  The applicant requests to construct a new single-story residence with an attached two-
  car garage. This requires one design review action pursuant to City Code Section
  23.15.03(B).
  (Required Action Date: 4/12/2021)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission continue the project
  to provide the applicant an opportunity to address design concerns.

  3. CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. CUP20-17 AND DESIGN REVIEW NO.
  DRC20-67
  2731 GAINSBOROUGH DR., (CHIH/LIN)
  The applicant requests to construct a one-story addition to a structure with an existing
  side yard setback of less than five feet (5’). This requires one design review action and
  one conditional use permit pursuant to City Code Sections 23.15.03(A)(3) and
  23.06.04(E)(2).
  (Required Action Date: 4/12/2021)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission adopt the attached
  resolution approving Conditional Use Permit No. CUP20-17 and Design Review No.
  DRC20-67 subject to the attached Conditions on Data Sheet No. 2.

  4. REQUEST FOR LOCAL HISTORICAL LANDMARK DESIGNATION
  1779 LOMBARDY RD., (DEWITT)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission adopt the attached
  resolution.

  OTHER MATTERS

  5. APPEAL OF DETERMINATION OF A TREE REMOVAL PERMIT
  1060 ROANOKE RD., (LIEB)
  The Planning Commission will consider the appeal of determination of a tree removal
  permit pursuant to City Code Section 23.06.15(E).

  6. REINTRODUCTION OF NATURAL WOOD SHAKE AND WOOD
  SHINGLE TO THE CITY’S PRE-APPROVED ROOF MATERIALS COLORS
  AND APPLICATION LIST

  7. RESOLUTION OF FINDINGS CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. CUP19-9,
  DESIGN REVIEW NOS. DRC19-27HP, DRC19-28, AND DRC19-97
  2275 S. OAK KNOLL AVE., (LUI/LCRA ARCHITECTS)

  8. RESOLUTION OF FINDINGS VARIANCE NOS. V20-01, V20-02, V20-03
  AND DESIGN REVIEW NO. DRC20-83HP
  1705 SHARON PL., (SHEN)

ORAL PUBLIC APPEARANCES

This is the time set aside for any person who desires to be heard on any matters not covered
on this agenda. No action is to be permitted except:

1.  Catastrophic Emergency as is described by majority vote; or
2.  The need for action arose within the last 72 hours as determined by a 4/5 vote.

PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at least a majority of the Planning
Commission regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at the public counter at
the San Marino City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California.

APPEALS

There is a fifteen day appeal period for all applications. All appeals should be filed with the City
Clerk. Please contact the City Clerk for further information.

ADJOURNMENT

The San Marino Planning Commission will adjourn to WEDNESDAY, APRIL 28, 2021, AT
7:00 P.M., pursuant to Executive Order N-29-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom, the
meeting will be held through teleconference.

Dated: March 19, 2021  ALDO CERVANTES
Posted: March 19, 2021  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR
